description: This C# source file defines an internal class OracleCommandInterceptor that implements ICommandInterceptor. It provides methods to modify Oracle database commands by setting properties such as BindByName, OracleDbType for specific parameters, and converting boolean parameters to integers. The class uses expression trees to compile lambda expressions for setting properties on Oracle command and parameter objects, bypassing some Oracle-specific behaviors.

classes.name: OracleCommandInterceptor
classes.description: An internal class that intercepts and modifies Oracle database commands to handle Oracle-specific behaviors, such as setting parameter types and command properties.

methods.name: BuildSetBindByNameAction
methods.description: Creates a lambda expression that sets the BindByName property of an OracleCommand to true.

methods.name: BuildSetOracleDbTypeAction
methods.description: Creates a lambda expression that sets the OracleDbType property of an OracleParameter to a specified enum value.

methods.name: Intercept
methods.description: Modifies the provided IDbCommand by setting parameter types and properties specific to Oracle, such as Clob, Blob, and boolean conversions.
